hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Maintain mappings from event names to registered subscriber callbacks or handler ids.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Support subscribing a listener, unsubscribing by identifier, and firing events in registration order.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Use dictionaries to achieve amortized constant time operations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Subscribe and unsubscribe take O(1) time; emit sorts k active listeners.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using unsorted lists without lookup sets leads to O(n) search on unsubscribe.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores event mapping for all registered listeners.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs clean pub-sub listener interface with set lookup.
